task_set.title: Year 2 governed support closure proof lab
task_set.intro: This rendered lab proves route-specific runtime, source, answer-form, and authority boundaries for Y2-B5-P13, Y2-B6-P12, Y2-B7-P13, and Y2-B8-P04. It is not generated lesson output.

contextBlocks.caption: Bron 1: Pension model 2024-2044
contextBlocks.bodyMarkdown: The approved source is a schematic pension model. It supports directional stock/flow and ratio reasoning, not exact student numeric extraction from the figure.
contextBlocks.accessibilitySummary: Schematic pension source with directional premium pressure and pension wealth relations.

contextBlocks.caption: Tabel 1: VastWonen/Reder route data
contextBlocks.altText: Table with Book 6 housing values used for waiting-list and revenue calculations.

contextBlocks.caption: Bron 2: Credit insurer, supplier, buyer, and Digibate table
contextBlocks.bodyMarkdown: The approved route names the credit insurer as principal and the buying company as agent. Expected damage is EUR 80,000 and the 20 percent markup gives a EUR 96,000 total premium.
contextBlocks.accessibilitySummary: Credit insurance route with actor-condition and expected-value calculation data.

contextBlocks.caption: Bron 3: Guarda/Orso Bianco price-war case
contextBlocks.bodyMarkdown: Use the official context first. Any payoff representation is derived and non-official, and must stay secondary to the official source facts.
contextBlocks.accessibilitySummary: Strategic price-war source with a derived payoff representation boundary.
